title: Hussain Ka Sar
body:
Bahan ke samne kaata gaya Hussain ka sar
Utha ke roti rahin Fatima Hussain ka sar
<<DIVIDER>>
Zameen pe aise giri phir nahi uthi Zainab
Jab uske samne kat kar gira Hussain ka sar
<<DIVIDER>>
Kabhi gala kabhi gardan pe maan ne haath rakha
Badan se hogaya phir bhi juda Hussain ka sar
<<DIVIDER>>
Unhein sanwara hai Zahra ne apne haathon se
Ae Shimr baalon se yun na uthaa Hussain ka sar
<<DIVIDER>>
Jahan pe rakha tha sandook mein sar-e-Akbar
Situmgaron ko waheen se mila Hussain ka sar
<<DIVIDER>>
Khushi manata tha Khuli, Batool roti theen
Jab ek tanoor mein rakha gaya Hussain ka sar
<<DIVIDER>>
Situmgaron ne kate sar ki bhi ragen kaateen
Safar mein aur bhi zakhmi hua Hussain ka sar
<<DIVIDER>>
Pakad ke baal Sakeena ko Shimr ne maara
Jab uske samne la kar rakha Hussain ka sar
<<DIVIDER>>
Lipat ke sogayi Zeeshan baap se beti
Andheri qaid mein jis dam mila Hussain ka sar
